verdict.rationale: Crossplane runs a control plane whose controllers keep working in the background: they automatically correct drift from desired state, and you configure that logic as function pipelines instead of writing controllers. Community comments corroborate that it has active controllers that react to failures and enforce state continuously. However, this background automation is limited to declarative infrastructure reconciliation rather than general-purpose automations a user sets up. Missing for 10: general-purpose or event/schedule-triggered automation setup, documentation of user-defined autonomous workflows beyond resource reconciliation, and hands-on evidence of AI-driven background agents.
